rooms.desc: Where it all begins. Warm soil, old wood, endless possibility.
rooms.flavor: Your grandmother's shed, inherited with love.
rooms.name: The Potting Shed

rooms.desc: Humid glass halls where seeds sprout in a hurry.
rooms.flavor: Everything grows faster under this glass.
rooms.name: The Fern Conservatory

rooms.desc: A glittering grotto that adores succulents.
rooms.flavor: The crystals hum to the succulents. They answer with Dewdrops.
rooms.name: The Crystal Cave

rooms.desc: A starlit dome. Unlocks Astral Flora and two extra solarium slots.
rooms.flavor: At night the glass shows the real sky. The plants noticed first.
rooms.name: The Astral Solarium
The Ember Forge
rooms.desc: A forge of gentle flame where fire-flowers are born.
rooms.flavor: Walls of warm ember-glass. The air smells like cinnamon and courage.

rooms.name: The Tide Pools
rooms.desc: Moonlit pools where ocean gardens grow.
rooms.flavor: Cool blue grottos. You can hear the sea breathing.

rooms.name: The Storm Spire
rooms.desc: A tower that catches lightning for its flowers.
rooms.flavor: Crackling crystal rods. The petals drink the storm.

rooms.name: The Honey Hollow
rooms.desc: A golden hive-hall of endless sweetness.
rooms.flavor: Amber light drips like honey. Everything glows.
